E-Commerce ERD

erDiagram
    customer {
        int id PK "nullable"
        varchar_255 email
        varchar_120 name "nullable"
    }
    order {
        int id PK "nullable"
        int customer_id FK
        order_status status "nullable, default 'pending'"
        decimal total "nullable"
    }
    product {
        int id PK "nullable"
        varchar_64 sku
    }
    customer_profile {
        int id PK "nullable"
        int customer_id FK,UK
        text bio "nullable"
    }
    order_item {
        int order_id PK,FK "nullable"
        int product_id PK,FK "nullable"
    }
    order }o--|| customer : "customer_id"
    customer_profile |o--|| customer : "customer_id"
    order ||--o{ order_item : "order_id"
    order_item }o--|| product : "product_id"
